summary: Under normal market conditions, the fund invests a majority of its net assets in equity and equity-related securities of non-U.S. companies located in various countries outside the U.S., including non-U.S. issuers located in emerging markets (identified by the subadviser as countries classified by MSCI as emerging and frontier markets). The subadviser uses a combination of fundamental research and systematic portfolio construction. The fund is non-diversified.
